## Type

- [ ] New skill
- [ ] Fix/improve an existing skill
- [ ] Tooling (`sploit`, `install.sh`, console, `catalog.py`)
- [ ] Docs

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `./tools/check.sh` and it passes (schema, generated indexes, lint).
- [ ] If I added or changed a skill, I regenerated and committed `CATALOG.md`, `COVERAGE.md`, and `docs/skills.json` (`python3 tools/catalog.py`).
- [ ] The skill **teaches the mechanism** (when · why · method · gotchas · verify) — not just a payload dump.
- [ ] No CTF/HTB branding, box names, flags, real targets, credentials, or secrets.
- [ ] This is for **authorized** security work (pentest / bug bounty / defense).
